text:
eva-partnerships: Kickoff for Meridian Systems marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need owners for: publisher IAM/KMS examples, legal addendum (KMS rotation + audit access), SKU manifest & pricing, staging screenshots, and co-marketing timeline. Who can take which?

sylvia-cloud: I can own the cloud artifacts (IAM role examples, GCP SA impersonation, Azure role assignment). Will post templates + a short Terraform snippet by Tue.

noah-legal: I'll handle the marketplace addendum. Meridian wants explicit BYOK (bring-your-own-key) language and a 120-day rotation option. Need final SKU IDs to reference in the contract.

omar-product: I'll map SKUs and tiering. Draft names: ["meridian-core-hourly", "meridian-core-monthly", "meridian-dedicated-reserved", "meridian-private-trial"]. Will upload CSV and price bands by Mon afternoon.

li-ops: Trials metadata: duration, seat cap, auto-terminate. Also confirm support contact and telemetry consent to appear in the listing. We should also define a trial termination webhook for partner callbacks.

tom-eng: I'll assemble staging screenshots, a 90s demo, and a short runbook for the publisher portal. Need staging publisher account creds.

eva-partnerships: Partner PM okayed anonymized telemetry share and wants a joint webinar. Propose we hold public launch until legal sign-off + a successful staging pass. Thoughts?

noah-legal: Agree to gating. If SKU CSV lands Mon I can draft addendum by Thu COB. Will include BYOK language + rotation window and a 30-day audit-log retrieval SLA.

sylvia-cloud: AWS assumeRole example to include in templates:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::PARTNER_ACCOUNT:role/MeridianPublisher"
    }
  ]
}
```

sylvia-cloud: GCP impersonation (gcloud) snippet:
```bash
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding meridian-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member='serviceAccount:publisher@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator'
```

sylvia-cloud: Azure role assignment (az cli):
```bash
az role assignment create --assignee-object-id <PUBLISHER_PRINCIPAL_ID> --role "Contributor" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>
```

omar-product: Noted. I'll include billing unit notes (core-hourly = v-token-minute). Will add SKU strings to the manifest doc so legal can reference them.

li-ops: For the trial webhook: propose field in manifest: "trial_end_callback_url" and a short retry/backoff doc. Partner confirmed they can receive callbacks.

tom-eng: Requesting staging creds from @eva-partnerships. Will upload screenshots and demo to the doc when ready.

eva-partnerships: Sending staging creds via secure channel now.

comm-bot: New doc added: /docs/marketplace/meridian-manifest-initial.md

sylvia-cloud: I'll open a PR with IAM + Terraform example. Will also include a short note about recommended KMS key policy for publisher access.

noah-legal: Reminder: Meridian asked for explicit SOC2 mention in the marketplace text. I'll draft a short blurb and the addendum.

omar-product: Uploaded SKU CSV and pricing bands. SKU list: ["meridian-core-hourly", "meridian-core-monthly", "meridian-dedicated-reserved", "meridian-private-trial"].

li-ops: Added trial metadata to the manifest and set support contact = marketplace-support@redwood.com. Also added the trial_end_callback_url field example.

tom-eng: Uploaded staging screenshots and a demo GIF to the doc. Running through staging smoke tests now.

eva-partnerships: Great progress. Proposed timeline: Tue IAM + TF PR; Wed legal draft in thread; Thu staging pass + final screenshots; Fri marketing draft for joint blog/webinar. Sync Fri 9:30am PT to finalize.

sylvia-cloud: Ack. Will ping when PR is up.

noah-legal: Will post draft addendum here Wed morning.

comm-bot: Reminder: marketplace launch checklist template v3 available in repo.

eva-partnerships: Thanks everyone 44d moving to action items.
